No directus_permissions rows created or mutated (no seed in repo; ALL-holders keep unrestricted grants). Canonical flat filter MINUTES_ATTENDEE_CREATE_FILTER (branch _in $CURRENT_USER.branch_ids + minute_status _eq draft + minute_created_by _eq $CURRENT_USER, pure _and, no _or) is the default for minutes_attendees:create grants in the admin endpoint; explicit admin filters still override (admin owns F1 then). Rollback drops trigger + function + index + both columns (derived, recompute on re-apply). F3 ruled: keep event_type 'note' permanently (cosmetic rename avoided). R1 (cap) and R2 (zod uuid) declined with rationale in the thread.
